parameters.pythonCode: # Loop over input items and add a new field called 'myNewField' to the JSON of each one # def wrap_orderid(order_id): # return f"""{order_id} # """ URL = r'https://admin.shopify.com/store/ultraceuticals-nz/orders/' def wrap_tr(string_to_wrap): return "" + str(string_to_wrap or "") + "" def wrap_td(string_to_wrap): return "" + str(string_to_wrap or "") + "" html_table = "" for item in _input.all(): html_line = "" html_line += wrap_td(item.json.name) html_line += wrap_td(item.json.risk_level) html_line += wrap_td(item.json.order_value_check) html_line += wrap_td(item.json.pick_list_status) html_line += wrap_td(item.json.all_check) html_line += wrap_td(item.json.release_order_status) html_table += wrap_tr(html_line) _input.last().json.html_table = html_table return _input.last()

order_number = 0
order_not_processed_number = 0
order_check_pass_number = 0
order_value_check_pass_number = 0
low_risk_number = 0
medium_risk_number = 0
high_risk_number = 0

for item in _input.all():
  # if item.json.risk_level != 'LOW':
  #   order_not_processed_number += 1
  #   pass

  order_number += 1
  
  if item.json.all_check == "PASS":
    order_check_pass_number += 1

  if item.json.order_value_check == "PASS":
    order_value_check_pass_number +=1

  if item.json.risk_level == "LOW":
    low_risk_number += 1

  if item.json.risk_level == "MEDIUM":
    medium_risk_number += 1

  if item.json.risk_level == "HIGH":
    high_risk_number += 1

order_processed_number = order_number - medium_risk_number - high_risk_number

_input.last().json.order_number = order_number
_input.last().json.order_check_pass_number = order_check_pass_number
_input.last().json.order_check_fail_number = order_processed_number - order_check_pass_number
_input.last().json.order_value_check_fail_number = order_processed_number - order_check_pass_number
_input.last().json.low_risk_number = low_risk_number
_input.last().json.medium_risk_number = medium_risk_number
_input.last().json.high_risk_number = high_risk_number

return _input.last()
